info.description: A production-ready REST API boilerplate in Go with JWT authentication
info.title: Go REST API Boilerplate

get.description: Get paginated list of all users with optional filtering (requires admin role)

parameters.description: Sort by field (created_at, updated_at, name, email)
parameters.name: sort

200.description: Success response with paginated user list

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password, returns access and refresh tokens

200.description: Success response with user data and tokens

500.description: Failed to authenticate user or generate token

post.description: Revoke refresh token and invalidate user session

403.description: Token does not belong to user

get.description: Get the currently authenticated user's information with roles

200.description: Success response with current user data

post.description: Exchange refresh token for new access and refresh tokens with automatic rotation

200.description: Success response with new token pair

403.description: Token reuse detected - all tokens revoked

post.description: Register a new user with name, email and password, returns access and refresh tokens

200.description: Success response with user data and tokens

500.description: Failed to register user or generate token

get.description: Get supported disbursement channels from SayaBayar
List the authenticated user's payments, optionally filtered by status

parameters.description: Filter by status (pending, paid, failed, expired, cancelled)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Create a payment invoice via SayaBayar for the authenticated user

get.description: Get a payment by ID; refreshes live status from SayaBayar when pending
Server-Sent Events stream of a payment's status. Sends the current status immediately, then live updates as SayaBayar webhooks are processed. The stream closes when the status becomes final.
Get a user by their ID (requires authentication)

200.description: Success response with updated user data

400.description: Invalid user ID or Validation error

delete.description: Delete a user by ID (requires authentication)

get.description: Get the authenticated user's wallet (created on first access)

post.description: Create a top-up invoice via SayaBayar; the wallet is credited when paid

get.description: Get a wallet top-up by ID
Server-Sent Events stream of a top-up's status, driven by the same payment reconciliation as webhooks. The stream closes when the status becomes final.
List the authenticated user's wallet ledger, optionally filtered by type

parameters.description: Filter by type (TOPUP, WITHDRAW, PAYMENT, REFUND, ADJUSTMENT)
parameters.name: type

post.description: Receives invoice.* and disbursement.* callbacks from SayaBayar; verifies the HMAC signature before reconciling payments, top-ups, and withdrawals

parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex of the raw body
parameters.name: X-Webhook-Signature

parameters.description: Event name (must match the payload event)
parameters.name: X-Webhook-Event

Resolve an account number to its account holder name via SayaBayar
